content.title: Chapter 70 - PERSONNEL RULES — Sec. 70-147. - Violence in the workplace.
content.summary:
Acts of violence, intimidation, or aggression will not be tolerated in the workplace.
               Any instance of violence, intimidation, or aggression must be reported to the employee's
               supervisor, risk management, or to the human resources department.
(
Ord. No. 4862
, § 1, 10-16…
